title: Scaled vector fields generate admissible deformations
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝᴺ open and Y : ℝᴺ → ℝᴺ of class C² with compact support and tsupport Y ⊆ U. Then there is a real c > 0 such that φ t x := x + (c t) • Y(x) satisfies IsAdmissibleDeformation 2 U (tsupport Y) φ and initialVelocity φ x = c • Y(x) for every x.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn N)) (Y : Rn N → Rn N), IsOpen U → ContDiff ℝ 2 Y → HasCompactSupport Y → tsupport Y ⊆ U → ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ IsAdmissibleDeformation 2 U (tsupport Y) (fun t x ↦ x + (c * t) • Y x) ∧ ∀ x, initialVelocity (fun t x ↦ x + (c * t) • Y x) x = c • Y x
